trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `v2.3.1` was unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history: `v2.3.0` was the last healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions — verified successful.
4. Opened incident **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.
